messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: control-plane · auth-service — elevated 5xx rate (20% error rate over 5m). Alert group: auth-org-lookup. Escalation level: pager -> eng-sre. Link: https://pager.redwood.example/incident/INC-3239991234

katie: on it. seeing spike in 5xx coming from auth -> org-lookup calls. first pass: is this rollout related? any deploys in the last 30m?

sam: no deploys in last 45m in controlplane. metrics: auth p50 latency normal, p95 up ~2x, errors are predominantly 502/504 and some gateway timeouts.

jia: pulling logs now. preliminary: org-lookup backend returning 502 upstream during heavy fanout. query pattern looks like increased fanout for some accounts. snippet:

```
2026-03-15T10:12:01Z auth svc req_id=abc123 org_lookup calling=org-lookup cluster=org-svc-01 upstream_status=502 latency_ms=12
2026-03-15T10:12:01Z auth svc req_id=abc124 org_lookup calling=org-lookup cluster=org-svc-02 upstream_status=200 latency_ms=14
2026-03-15T10:12:02Z auth svc req_id=abc125 org_lookup calling=org-lookup cluster=org-svc-01 upstream_status=502 latency_ms=120
```

jia: looks like one org-lookup cluster (org-svc-01) is failing under partial load. could be network or instance memory pressure.

katie: quick impact check: which customers affected? any public-facing outages?

matt: CSM flagged a customer alerting on errors in their product. surface-level: API requests for signed-in users failing with 502 at token exchange path. severity: degraded for some customers, intermittent. recommend page product/CSM after we stabilize.

sam: mitigation options: 1) route auth->org lookup traffic away from org-svc-01 (if healthy nodes exist) 2) enable cached lookup fallback in auth for 1m 3) increase circuit-breaker for org-lookup to fail-fast and fallback sooner 4) scale org-svc ASG/replicas (hot scale) 5) rollback any recent config change (no recent deploys though)

katie: can we flip cached fallback? it's low risk and buys time. who can run the toggle?

jia: I can flip. config path: `/services/auth/feature-flags/org_lookup_cache_fallback` currently false. running: `curl -XPOST https://config.internal/v1/flags/org_lookup_cache_fallback -d '{"value":true}'`

ops-bot: config-change requested by jia: org_lookup_cache_fallback=true (audited). change id=cfg-76423.

katie: flipping now.

jia: flipped. monitoring...

sam: seeing reduced upstream pressure to org-svc-01 within 90s. 5xx dropping from 20% -> 6% in last 2m. nice. keep monitoring.

matt: good. we should still work the root cause. jia can you open a ticket for org-svc-01 health + node metrics? include heap/ooms, CPU, network errors.

jia: created ticket ORG-9876: investigate org-svc-01 partial failures. attaching logs + pod list.

katie: next step: scale org-svc ASG by +2 replicas as precaution. sam, do you want to handle?

sam: scaling now: `kubectl scale deployment/org-lookup --replicas=10 -n platform` -> started. 3 new pods provisioning.

ops-bot: autoscaler event: 3 pods created for deployment/org-lookup.

sam: new pods are healthy. traffic redistributed. 5xx steady ~2-3%. good.

matt: customer impact update: reduced. CSMs notified that mitigation in flight; aim to send short customer note if stable for 30m.

katie: quick postmortem plan: keep cached fallback on until root cause fixed and org-svc cluster is stable. do a canary disable later. also add a rollout guard to limit fanout concurrency for org-lookup for high-traffic accounts.

luis: i'm incoming for handoff in 20m. anything I should watch for?

katie: summary for handoff -> luis: incident INC-3239991234. root cause: partial failures in org-svc-01 causing auth->org-lookup fanout to generate 502s. mitigation applied: org_lookup_cache_fallback=true, scaled org-lookup deployment +2 replicas. current state: 5xx ~2-3%, traffic normal. tickets: ORG-9876 open. keep an eye for error spike >5% or autoscaler thrash. oncall playbook: if 5xx rises -> disable traffic to org-svc-01 via host routing, or rollback recent config (none), or escalate to infra.

luis: ack. will monitor for 60m and then confirm stable. i will also notify next-tier infra if we see host-level networking errors.

sam: additional telemetry note: add a per-cluster org-lookup success metric grafana panel for quicker triage. filing quick ticket MET-4321.

matt: product/public comms: wait until stable 30m window then send status update. if >10% errors recur, send immediate update.

ops-bot: incident-bot: incident INC-3239991234 status: mitigation applied, degraded -> partial recovery. current error rate: 2.6% (5m). assigned oncall: luis.

katie: handing off to luis now. I'm going to log off in 15m. thanks team. :pray:

luis: taking over. will post final stable/close once 60m stable window passes or earlier if escalated.

incident-bot: Reminder: please update the incident runbook with timelines and config toggle ids before close.

katie: noted. runbook updated (flip id: cfg-76423, ticket ORG-9876, scale event id: scale-3219).

luis: final note before monitoring: if we see repeated host-level 502s, escalate to infra oncall and consider emergency drain of org-svc-01 nodes.

matt: thanks everyone. good quick mitigation. will standby for final close + postmortem schedule.

luis: closing handoff at 3239991899.
